subject.title: feat(plugins): beam local coding sessions into a read-only catalog

question: Should this optional coding-session sharing capability ship as a bundled OpenClaw plugin, or remain an externally distributed plugin paired with the companion skill?
rationale: The implementation uses current plugin APIs and introduces no demonstrated missing core extension seam, while bundled distribution makes OpenClaw own a new authenticated ingress and its long-term support boundary.

options.title: Publish it externally
options.body: Keep the companion skill and distribute Beam as an installable plugin so the optional integration does not expand the bundled product surface.

options.title: Sponsor bundled Beam
options.body: Accept first-party ownership of the authenticated ingress and document the Gateway-wide read visibility as the supported trust model.

recommendation.title: Publish it externally
recommendation.body: Keep the companion skill and distribute Beam as an installable plugin so the optional integration does not expand the bundled product surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies steipete as the feature’s design and implementation contact and the PR is already marked for maintainer handling.
